existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: No hard local R4→R6 validation break was found for `EnrollmentRequest`. The main concern is that R6 allows `EnrollmentRequest.candidate` to reference `Group`, while R4 allowed only `Patient`; the top uncertainty is the absence of an official narrative diff explaining intended migration semantics.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Forward migration is low friction for existing base R4 instances because local elements and cardinalities are preserved and the required `status` code set is unchanged. Mixed R4/R6 exchange is riskier: R6 Group candidates need explicit handling for R4 validators, R4 generated models, reporting logic, and business workflows that previously treated enrollment candidate as a single patient.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for the computable delta because both assigned StructureDefinitions exist under the same canonical URL and the local element diff is small. Confidence in rationale and real-world prevalence is medium because official change notes, rendered narrative pages, and deployment profiles were not available in the local inputs.
